doodles.subject: Baby Sea Turtle
doodles.caption:
✨ 𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗧𝗼 𝗗𝗿𝗮𝘄: 𝗕𝗮𝗯𝘆 𝗦𝗲𝗮 𝗧𝘂𝗿𝘁𝗹𝗲 (Ocean & Marine Life) ✨

Here is an easy 4-step sketching guide for your sketchbook today! ✏️🎨

🔹 𝗦𝘁𝗲𝗽 𝟭: Start with light, loose construction shapes and proportions.
🔹 𝗦𝘁𝗲𝗽 𝟮: Refine the gentle contours and shape gliding gently with a tiny smooth ocean pebble tucked near its flipper.
🔹 𝗦𝘁𝗲𝗽 𝟯: Add crisp clean line art, texture details, and depth.
🔹 𝗦𝘁𝗲𝗽 𝟰: Finish with soft colored pencils for cozy warmth!

💬 𝗪𝗵𝗶𝗰𝗵 𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗽 𝘄𝗮𝘀 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗳𝗮𝘃𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘁𝗲? 𝗚𝗿𝗮𝗯 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝘀𝗸𝗲𝘁𝗰𝗵𝗯𝗼𝗼𝗸 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗴𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗶𝘁 𝗮 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝘁𝗼𝗱𝗮𝘆! 👇

doodles.prompt: A master-level 4-panel step-by-step 2D drawing tutorial sheet showing how to sketch a cute Baby Sea Turtle gliding gently with a tiny smooth ocean pebble tucked near its flipper. The drawing sheet is organized into a clean 2x2 grid of four equal panels on plain off-white textured sketchbook paper. STRICT 4-PANEL PROGRESSION: - Panel 1 (Top-Left): STEP 1 - Light, delicate pencil construction guidelines, simple geometric basic shapes, and circle gesture scaffolding showing initial placement. - Panel 2 (Top-Right): STEP 2 - Confident contour line drawings defining primary anatomy, silhouette, shape, and gliding gently with a tiny smooth ocean pebble tucked near its flipper. - Panel 3 (Bottom-Left): STEP 3 - Clean refined line art with fine ink details, textures, hatching, and subtle shading accents. - Panel 4 (Bottom-Right): STEP 4 - Completely finished, vibrant artwork cleanly colored with soft colored pencils in warm harmonious tones with golden autumn oak leaves, tiny acorns, and cozy warm pumpkin hues. MANDATORY UNIVERSAL CONSTRAINTS: 1. ZERO HANDS & ZERO ARTIST TOOLS: Absolutely NO human hands, NO fingers, NO arms, NO pencils, NO pens, NO erasers, and NO desks. Flat 2D drawing paper view only. 2. ZERO TEXT & LABELS: Absolutely NO words, NO titles, NO letters, NO step numbers, NO arrows, and NO written labels anywhere on the canvas. 3. PERSPECTIVE & POSE LOCK: The camera angle, perspective view, and exact physical pose established in Panel 1 must stay 100% identical in Panels 2, 3, and 4. 4. SILHOUETTE CONTINUITY: Zero morphing, tilting, or changing direction between panels. Every accessory and prop introduced must stay consistent across all panels. Artistic Style: Professional Japanese studio illustration, clean lineart, cozy aesthetic, high aesthetic quality, pristine studio presentation.
